What is CAS and why do I need it?

CAS stands for Consolidated Account Statement, issued by CAMS and KFin Technologies. It lists the investments linked to your email ID and PAN.
Why is CAS important?
  • Track Investments: It helps you see all your investments in one place.
  • Transparency: It gives a view of your portfolio, making it easy to monitor performance.
  • Tax Filing: It is handy for tax filing as it shows your capital gains.
